title: cyanea rollandia
intro: Cyanea rollandia, commonly known as the Hawaiian lobelia, is a flowering plant endemic to the Hawaiian Islands. It is a shrub-like plant that belongs to the family Campanulaceae, known for its blue flowers and medicinal properties. The Hawaiian lobelia is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects.
